claim_boundary: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED_CAPABILITY only; finite pure DSL invention, not arbitrary program/effectful tool invention or AGI.
critical_unknowns: DSL opcode vocabulary remains hand-designed and finite; R2.56 does not invent new syntax/evaluator semantics.
Only pure in-memory transforms are inventable; effectful tool/operator invention is not proven.
Authored benchmark is synthetic and independent transfer covers one narrow external pure function family.
Search cost can explode with depth/arity; no large open-ended synthesis scalability proof exists.
Challenge suites can miss observationally equivalent but wrong expressions outside sampled domains.
No broad autonomous repository-repair improvement is directly measured by R2.56.
External oracle execution still requires trusted/sandboxed source handling for hostile code.
Natural-language task decomposition into the correct invention need is not proven.
